item.title: Refund and Returns Policy
item.dc:creator: appx
item.content:encoded:
This is a sample page.

Overview

Our refund and returns policy lasts 30 days. If 30 days have passed since your purchase, we can’t offer you a full refund or exchange.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging.

Several types of goods are exempt from being returned. Perishable goods such as food, flowers, newspapers or magazines cannot be returned. We also do not accept products that are intimate or sanitary goods, hazardous materials, or flammable liquids or gases.

Additional non-returnable items:

  • Gift cards
  • Downloadable software products
  • Some health and personal care items

To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase.

Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer.

There are certain situations where only partial refunds are granted:

  • Book with obvious signs of use
  • CD, DVD, VHS tape, software, video game, cassette tape, or vinyl record that has been opened.
  • Any item not in its original condition, is damaged or missing parts for reasons not due to our error.
  • Any item that is returned more than 30 days after delivery

Refunds

Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.

If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days.

Late or missing refunds

If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again.

Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted.

Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted.

If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at {email address}.

Sale items

Only regular priced items may be refunded. Sale items cannot be refunded.

Exchanges

We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange it for the same item, send us an email at {email address} and send your item to: {physical address}.

Gifts

If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you’ll receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be mailed to you.

If the item wasn’t marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and they will find out about your return.

Shipping returns

To return your product, you should mail your product to: {physical address}.

You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.

Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you may vary.

If you are returning more expensive items, you may consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.

Need help?

Contact us at {email} for questions related to refunds and returns.

item.title: FAQ
item.dc:creator: appx
item.content:encoded:
I don’t remember my password, what do I do?

Click the Lost your password? Link just under the Portal login box.

How long does my order take to receive?

Your order will generally take 10 days or less from the first business day following the placement of your order (i.e. You place your order on a Friday, the 10-day clock will start on Monday with Monday being the first day).

Can I purchase my items in store the same day?

Yes, if the items are in stock at the store, you can purchase the same day except items requiring embroidery.  All transactions however, must still be rung through the Portal.  BareBones may have items that are for sizing only so we may also reserve those for fitting and then order from such fitting accordingly.

Can I backorder items? If so, how long will backorders generally take?

Yes, you can backorder items and generally will be shown the expected “back in stock” date for the particular item in the color/size you are looking for.  If the item has been discontinued or has a backorder date of over 3 months, an “Out of Stock” message may be displayed and the item may be prevented from being added to the cart.  (Exception to this are Dragonwear items that will allow for backorder despite backorder timeframe.  It is important that any SMUD employee who adds such items to the cart understands that backorder dates can be further delayed from this particular company.)

Does BareBones provide Hemming/Customizing/Repairs and how do I go about getting this done in the Portal?

Yes, BareBones provides these services however we reserve the right to decline if the product will not hem well in the way requested, cannot be customized in the way requested, and/or the product is too worn or damage is too large to make a compliant repair.  Although rarely used, these services are free to SMUD employees.  In the Portal, you will just make a note upon checkout and state which items you would like altered.

Can I return my items? Even if they have the SMUD logo on them?

BareBones definitely requests that you try on your items (or like items for fit) first as to not “waste” product in a returns process.  With that said, you can return any brand-new items even if they have the SMUD logo within 30 days of receiving date.  Items must be UNWASHED, SHOW NO SIGNS OF WEAR, AND BE IN PERFECTLY RESELLABLE CONDITION INCLUDING TAGS AND ORIGINAL PACKAGING.  The return may be declined if BareBones staff determines that the items cannot be resold to another SMUD employee as perfectly new.

It think my product may be defective, what do I do?

Return your item to the nearest BareBones WorkWear location for evaluation and if determined the item is defected, you will receive credit on your allowance account within 3 business days.

Will I be notified if there is a recall on any of the products that I have purchased

Yes, if you purchased any product that has been recalled by the manufacturer, you and SMUD management will receive an email explaining what is being recalled and what actions to take

Can I buy products not shown in the SMUD FR Apparel Portal?

By contract, you will not be allowed to purchase any item using your SMUD funds that is not for purchase within the Portal.  This includes outside products from vendors who do have some product on the portal, plaids, or other non-approved items.  You may always purchase other BareBones merchandise using your own funds.

How do I suggest a new product to add for the Portal?

Please visit the Help Center for your contact for new product suggestions

What products will get the SMUD logo embroidered and where?

All tops including shirts, jackets, and sweatshirts (except Dri-fire base layer shirts) will be embroidered with the SMUD logo per SMUD guidelines and usually on the left breast unless there is a high zipper or pocket preventing this and then it may be moved to the right breast.  On rare occasions (like when there is high visibility striping), the logo may be moved to the left shoulder/sleeve.

Can I bring in my own products to be embroidered? Can I say where to embroider?

If the product is on the accepted list displayed in the Portal, you may and BareBones will embroider at no charge per standard guidelines.  Special requests for placement will not be considered.  If the items being brought in are not in the Portal, BareBones will not embroider.  BareBones also reserves the right to not embroider if the item shows excessive wear/age.

Will BareBones price match another retailer or website if I happen to find a better price?

BareBones has contracted with SMUD for exact pricing so price matching will not be considered at this time.

Will I still receive my SMUD discount of 12% on footwear?

SMUD employees will still be allowed to receive a 12% discount up to two boot transactions within 12 months.

Will BareBones price match footwear?

BareBones is committed to getting you the best price on footwear.  This means we will apply your 12% SMUD discount or match the price whichever is cheapest for you.  We won’t price match and then apply the 12% SMUD discount.

Can I spend over my allotted amount?

Yes, you can by using a personal credit card or PayPal

Are there size charts that will allow for better sizing when ordering online?

Yes, there will be a link on the Product Detail page for the item you are interested in for most items.

How will I be notified that my product has arrived at a store for pickup?

You will receive a text message notifying you which product(s) have arrived for your order.  You may receive a phone call if there is a question on your order, you have not picked up your item(s) after an excessive amount of time, or there is any other communication in which text messages are not deemed appropriate by BareBones WorkWear staff. For Help Center, please replace the user manual with the one attached

Who do I contact for technical issues with the website?

Please contact Mason Moore at 916-287-9106 (smudhelp@barebonesworkwear.com) or BareBones – Rancho Cordova at 916-363-9327
